original_question: Prove Ivrii's conjecture for 3-periodic multidimensional outer symplectic billiards with respect to a strictly convex closed hypersurface.
target_in_paper: The exact target is the unnumbered Problem in Serge Tabachnikov’s subsection "Ivrii’s conjecture for outer symplectic billiards": "Problem: prove Ivrii’s conjecture for 3-periodic multidimensional outer symplectic billiards with respect to a strictly convex closed hypersurface." ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2602.12896))
correct_elements: Your draft is already essentially verbatim the paper’s official problem statement and correctly captures the period 3, the multidimensional outer symplectic billiard setting, and the strictly convex closed hypersurface assumption. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2602.12896))
missing_details: To make the question stand-alone, you should unpack "Ivrii’s conjecture" in the form given immediately before the problem: it is the assertion that the set of periodic orbits has zero measure with respect to the measure associated with the invariant symplectic structure on the phase space; the same type of statement is then said to apply to outer symplectic billiards. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2602.12896))

The zero-measure claim should be stated specifically for the set of 3-periodic orbits (equivalently, phase-space points generating 3-periodic trajectories), since the paper asks only for the period-3 case. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2602.12896))

It helps to mention explicitly that the measure statement is about the phase space of the associated outer symplectic billiard, not just about the hypersurface itself. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2602.12896))

If you want the formulation fully explicit, add the quantifier "for every strictly convex closed hypersurface"; the paper does not impose extra symmetry, analyticity, or additional dimension-specific hypotheses beyond saying "multidimensional." ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2602.12896))

No ambient ring/field, homogeneity, degree restriction, nilpotency condition, or "sufficiently large m" quantifier is relevant here; the hidden data are geometric and measure-theoretic instead. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2602.12896))
refined_question: Let Σ be a strictly convex closed hypersurface, and consider the associated multidimensional outer symplectic billiard. Prove the period-3 case of Ivrii’s conjecture: the set of phase-space points whose outer symplectic billiard trajectories are 3-periodic has zero measure with respect to the invariant symplectic measure on the phase space. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2602.12896))
justification: The draft clearly targets Serge Tabachnikov’s unnumbered problem, not Conjecture 1 or Problems 1–3 in a different part of the paper. The only nearby official expansion of the shorthand "Ivrii’s conjecture" is the immediately preceding contextual sentence saying that, for conventional billiards, the conjecture asserts zero measure of periodic orbits with respect to the measure associated with the invariant symplectic structure of the phase space, and that a similar conjecture applies to outer symplectic billiards. The exact open problem then specializes this to 3-periodic multidimensional outer symplectic billiards for a strictly convex closed hypersurface. No proposition, theorem, or remark in this paper provides an explicit equivalent reformulation of this particular problem, so none should be added. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2602.12896))
